physical_and_accuracy.product_formula: ordered symmetric S2; all original frames; no PR split
physical_and_accuracy.representation: ordinary number; original-g corrected kappa and scalar; original frame order

environments.policy: Use separate read-only task fit/eval interpreters. Venv python uses absolute(), never resolve(). Never modify existing/shared environments.

input_generation.factory: PySCF RHF canonical MO + ao2mo.kernel/restore(1); chemist g; original h/g/c retained
input_generation.geometry: H atoms at (0,0,i) Angstrom, neutral singlet, STO-3G
input_generation.export: input.npz h/g/constant/mo_coeff; input_identity.json with bytes SHA256 before any fit
input_generation.historical_reuse: h4_molecular_inputs.py at 0c329b30; no old numerical inputs/results are decoded in preparation

rank_selection.CDF: Requested rank ascending 1..n(n+1)/2; one fixed ffsim0.0.83 ordinary optimize=True call per rank, tol1e-8/L-BFGS-B/cholesky initialization. First rank whose physical-sector norm+guard <= CA/8. No restarts or monotonicity assumption.
rank_selection.XDF: Fixed ffsim explicit modified-Cholesky optimize=False decomposition once at n(n+1)/2,tol1e-8; evaluate prefixes in original order, select first physical-sector norm+guard passing same budget. No fit/optimizer.
rank_selection.XDF_baseline_change: This is a new explicit XDF algorithm policy; it does not import H4 OpenFermion-eigh rank10 or its numerical result. Both arms share original h/g/c and corrected kappa.
rank_selection.failure: Nonconverged optimizer or numerical/schema FAIL -> partial evidence and STOP; ladder exhausted -> DF_BUDGET_NOT_MET, no PF/native. No automatic rank expansion.
rank_selection.actual_rank: Store requested and actual export rank separately; no rank8/rank10 inheritance
rank_selection.guard_qualification: New engineering proposal, not a rigorous enclosure and not an amendment of H4 binary64_operation_scale_guard8_v1.

error_separation.DF: physical-sector operator norm of Hphys-H_DF in Ha, measured independently per arm plus declared numerical guard
error_separation.adapter: sparse raw J/U CAR vs independent general K I/Z/ZZ expansion on selected complete sector-preserving factors; max-entry1e-10
error_separation.PF: spectral operator error of complete sector S2 evolution vs exact DF evolution at each delta*2^m; no old perturbative coefficient substitution
error_separation.synthesis_H2: full32 raw/compiled/CAR phase-preserving residuals; norm2<=Frobenius + unitary telescoping for n=s*2^m and head/X/Y; numerical pilot only
error_separation.shots_H2: Existing assess_round/Hoeffding after numerical PF+synthesis qualification; same CA,phase,alpha budgets; new molecule-specific N, no H4 shot reuse
error_separation.costs_H2: P0-native kernel repeated with fences, X/Y readout once, exact deterministic support; sum N_axis*cost, no state preparation
error_separation.rigorous: DF/PF/expm/Operator/SCF reference rounding is not enclosed; numerical CA PASS is never a rigorous certificate

H6_plan.backend: 400-dimension physical Nalpha=Nbeta3 sector; reuse PhysicalSector/_build_excitation_table + sparse bilinears; dense sector matrices only
H6_plan.sector_legality: Each complete h/kappa, spin-lifted density and DF frame conserves Nalpha/Nbeta. No projection between nonconserving Gaussian elementary gates.
H6_plan.physical_reference: Existing OpenFermion JW sparse physical Hamiltonian; restrict then densify400 only. No full dense4096.
H6_plan.PF: Cached S2 substep and physical eigenbasis; repeated squaring for m0..12; max400x400,4 independent arm/s tasks.
H6_plan.XDF_cache: Reuse each explicit-XDF prefix frame rather than rebuilding earlier frames at every rank
H6_plan.native_status: EXCLUDED from initial H6 execution. Native build/compile alone is plausible but unbenchmarked; full8192 Operator verification prohibited in this scope.
H6_plan.next_decision: After H6 DF/PF pilot and resource timings, decide whether native-cost-only + separate matrix-free/state-action synthesis validation is justified. No automatic continuation.

call_units.scf: one existing RHF solve, no FCI
call_units.explicit_XDF: one existing ffsim nonoptimized decomposition in separate worker
call_units.CDF_fit: one existing ffsim optimized rank call, never retries
call_units.rank_assessment: one rank-specific raw CAR sector reconstruction/physical norm/engineering guard
call_units.ground_alias: one physical/DF sector eigensolve+residual+alias branch check
call_units.sector_kernel_reference: one whole selected-sector S2 kernel with per-block exponentials and DF eigenbasis
call_units.PF_round_assessment: one spectral PF error at delta*2^m; repeated squaring, not 2^m matrix multiplications
call_units.full_generators: H2 selected arm full CAR base/frames
call_units.full_kernel_reference: H2 selected arm/s one full16 S2 reference
call_units.gaussian_build: one unique Gaussian rotation, cached per arm/source
call_units.circuit_build: one complete kernel or head/X/Y segment
call_units.compile: one unchanged P0 compilation, serial task-local dispatch
call_units.operator_decode: one raw or compiled full32 Operator
call_units.round_accuracy: one old RPE accuracy/shot evaluation at fixed round

execution_order: Separate chat permission for the named H2 and/or H6 scope; no approval-proof or grant system
SOURCE/env/conditions preflight; one selected molecule per command and fresh output
One common original h/g/c generation and snapshot; sparse physical-sector CAR context
XDF first passing prefix then CDF first passing rank, preserve every attempted rank and optimizer result; no unregistered search
Both arms must meet DF reserve; selected general-K equivalence and physical/own-DF ground/alias gates
H6 saves DF/PF and STOP; native/synthesis/shots/cost remain unknown
H2 only full native/P0/relative-phase tests -> round CA/shots -> qualified cost comparison -> STOP

STOP.first_fit_or_correctness_or_contract_fai: Stop dependent work, drain active workers, preserve partial evidence; retry/resume0
STOP.DF_budget_fail: Persist DF_BUDGET_NOT_MET and STOP without PF/native
STOP.PF_or_CA_insufficient: Record numerical sufficient-condition ineligibility; no CA-qualified cost for that candidate; not physical impossibility
STOP.completion: mandatory STOP after result publication/remote verification

performance: No artificial CPU/RAM/wall caps. Existing resource-plan chooses candidate workers from actual affinity/quota/RAM; fit ranks sequential for first-passing policy; fit environment separate. H6 no full dense arrays; 400-sector operator norms affordable to test. No speedup claims without timing.
approval_policy: Chat permission only; no certificate, approval record, identity system or new grant.
